[[File:Lightning.jpg|right|thumb|250px|Lightning being called.]]
'''Calling Lightning''' is a [[weave]] associated with the [[Talent]] in weather, also known as [[Cloud Dancing]]. This weave uses Fire and Air. Calling lightning is a very easy task, even channelers who are poor at manipulating the weather can call lightning with ease.

==Examples of use==
The first occurrence of this weave is found when [[Rand]] and [[Mat]] are cornered in an inn by [[Darkfriend]]s. Rand uses lightning to break a hole in the wall while eliminating the threat of the Darkfriends. When he pulls Mat from the wreckage, he notes that there is not a single cloud in the sky.{{Verify}}

This is likely the second time that [[Rand]] uses the [[One Power]]; the first being when he used a [[refresh]] weave on [[Bela]].

Nynaeve al'Meara makes use of this weave multiple times as a defensive mechanism.
